items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Bauvorbescheid
items.quote: Rechtsbehelf: Widerspruch. Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Letter is dated Monday 02.03.2026 and sent by ordinary mail from a German authority. Under § 41 Abs. 2 LVwVfG BW, a letter sent by post is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting, i.e. Thursday 05.03.2026 (no indication it arrived later). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from this Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the triggering event, 05.03.2026, is not counted). Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same date as the triggering event, i.e. 05.04.2026. However, 05.04.2026 is a Sunday (in fact Easter Sunday). Per § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period falls on a Sunday, holiday or Saturday, the period ends on the next working day. The following day, 06.04.2026 (Ostermontag/Easter Monday), is also a statutory public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so the deadline moves to the next working day, Tuesday 07.04.2026.

warnings: The letter states that a separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) will follow with the amount to be paid; no amount or due date for that fee is given in this letter, so it must be tracked separately once received.
